rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a person or action showing care and kindness toward others.

example.english: They took the injured stray cat to the vet right away; that was really humane.
example.traditional: 佢見到流浪貓受傷，即刻帶佢去睇獸醫，真係好有愛心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 lau4 long6 maau1 sau6 soeng1 zik1 hak1 daai2 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 sau3 ji1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when stressing sympathy for someone or something that is suffering.

example.english: You were very humane toward your unemployed friend, so they must be grateful.
example.traditional: 你對住個失業嘅朋友咁有同情心，佢一定好感激。
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 zyu6 go3 sat1 jip6 ge3 pang4 jau5 gam3 jau5 tung4 cing4 sam1 keoi5 jat1 ding6 hou2 gam2 gik1

rows.note: Use this especially for treatment or methods that avoid causing unnecessary suffering, such as treatment of animals.

example.english: This farm uses humane methods to raise livestock and avoid causing them unnecessary suffering.
example.traditional: 呢間農場採用人道方法飼養禽畜，避免佢哋受不必要嘅痛苦。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 nung4 coeng4 coi2 jung6 jan4 dou6 fong1 faat3 zi6 joeng5 kam4 cuk1 bei6 min5 keoi5 dei6 sau6 bat1 bit1 jiu3 ge3 tung3 fu2
